summary: Add capped whole-word construction terminology expansion to local project-question retrieval.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued accuracy and adaptability for RFI, Submittal and Email content
A synthetic reproduction showed accepted could not retrieve a later approved Submittal status
A second reproduction showed substring scoring treated size inside oversized as an exact match
approval_evidence: The active improvement goal explicitly covers project efficiency, accuracy and RFI/Submittal/Email adaptability.
known_limitations: The vocabulary is deliberately narrow and does not provide general semantic or multilingual retrieval.
Shop Drawing and Product Data expand to Submittal only when those complete phrases occur in the question.
Validation uses synthetic offline evidence and does not establish construction accuracy on customer documents.
